evidence.why: Supabase user_metadata is client-writable (via auth.updateUser from the browser); using it as the admin authorization source is authorization from an untrusted identity claim rather than a server-verified role (should use app_metadata or a server-side roles table).
Role-elevation gate relies on the same untrusted isAdmin flag, so the role field can effectively be made writable by a user who has set their own user_metadata.role to 'admin'.

other_classes_observed: information disclosure via 404 instead of 403 is minor, not scored
